summary: Firefox’s WebRTC codec checks are now more accurate and coordinated: MediaCapabilities, the web API that reports media support, uses strict create-and-probe tests and shared asynchronous checks for encoding and decoding. AV1, H.264, hardware encoders on Android, and WebRTC GMP plugins are handled more reliably, while QualityScaler can now use H.264 picture-quality data to adjust video quality. This helps websites choose codecs that Firefox can actually use and avoid failed calls or poor performance.
